# Code generated from the LinkML model

This directory holds the output that the [LinkML generators](https://linkml.io/linkml/generators/index.html)
write from the model in `src/github_actions/schema/github_actions.yaml`.
A generator turns a LinkML schema into another datamodel, such as SQL or RDF, or into another artefact,
such as a JSON Schema, a visualisation or Markdown documentation.
